_tooltips.entityName: The entity type whose records this state machine controls, e.g. order. Each entity type can have only one state machine, and the value cannot be changed after the first save.
_tooltips.name: A readable name for the state machine, e.g. Order lifecycle.
_tooltips.description: A note for you and your fellow designers; users do not see it.
_tooltips.stateAttributeKey: The attribute of the entity that holds the record's current state, e.g. status. It must exist on the entity and be a text or enum attribute; only the state machine writes it.
_tooltips.initialStateKey: The key of the state every new record starts in, e.g. NEW. It must match the key of one of the states below.
_tooltips.version: Increases with every save. Set by the system.
_tooltips.updatedAt: When the state machine was last saved. Set by the system.
_tooltips.releaseState: Whether the running application uses this state machine as it stands: NEW was never published, CHANGED differs from what was published, RELEASED is what the application uses. Publish in the Release section to change it. Set by the system.
_tooltips.states: The states a record can be in, one row per state, e.g. NEW, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED. At least one is required.
_tooltips.transitions: The allowed moves from one state to another, one row per move, e.g. approve: NEW → CONFIRMED. A record can only change state along a transition listed here.

_tooltips.key: The exact value stored in the record's state attribute while it is in this state, e.g. CONFIRMED. Unique within the state machine; transitions refer to the state by it.
_tooltips.name: The state's name as users see it, e.g. Confirmed.
_tooltips.description: What this state means for the record, as a note for you and your fellow designers.
_tooltips.isFinal: Tick it for an end state, e.g. CLOSED or CANCELLED: no transition may lead out of it.
_tooltips.isLocked: Tick it to freeze records in this state: their other fields can no longer be edited, only the state itself can change.
_tooltips.metadata: Optional display hints for drawing the state in the State Modeler, as name and value pairs, e.g. color = #2e7d32.

_tooltips.key: Identifies the transition, unique within the state machine, e.g. confirm-order.
_tooltips.name: Optional readable name of the transition, e.g. Confirm order.
_tooltips.sourceStateKey: The key of the state the record must be in for this transition to be offered, e.g. NEW. It cannot be a terminal state.
_tooltips.targetStateKey: The key of the state the record moves into, e.g. CONFIRMED.
_tooltips.triggerKey: The action that fires the transition, e.g. approve. Only one transition per source state may use the same trigger, but the same trigger may lead elsewhere from another state.
_tooltips.guards: Conditions checked in order before the transition may happen; the first that fails blocks it. Leave empty if the transition is always allowed.
_tooltips.actions: Steps run in order once every guard has passed, e.g. sending a notification.

_tooltips.beanName: The name of the server-side guard that checks the condition, e.g. sufficientBalanceGuard. Ask your developers for the available names; an unknown name is rejected on save.
_tooltips.params: Optional settings for the guard, as name and value pairs, e.g. minBalance = 100. Which names it understands depends on the guard.

_tooltips.beanName: The name of the server-side action to run, e.g. sendApprovalNotificationAction. Ask your developers for the available names; an unknown name is rejected on save.
_tooltips.params: Optional settings for the action, as name and value pairs, e.g. recipient = sales@example.com. Which names it understands depends on the action.

entity_state_machine.noMachine: No state machine governs this entity type.
entity_state_machine.unknownState: '{{state}}' is not a state this machine declares.
entity_state_machine.readOnly: Read-only view — the machine is authored under Base State.
entity_state_machine.noState: This record has no state yet.

state_control.noTransitions: No transition is available from this state.
state_control.blockedNoReason: Not allowed by a guard of this transition.
